summary.tldr: Amends the Criminal Code so a mental disorder is not a grievous and irremediable medical condition for medical assistance in dying.
what_it_does: Replaces the Criminal Code rule on medical assistance in dying to state that a mental disorder is not a grievous and irremediable medical condition.
Keeps that exclusion tied to the existing MAID test in subsection 241.2(2).
Adds coordinating changes so the new rule and the 2021 MAID amendment act line up, no matter which comes into force first.
who_it_affects: People seeking medical assistance in dying
summary.background: The bill amends the Criminal Code. It also includes coordinating changes with the 2021 Act to amend the Criminal Code (medical assistance in dying).
